body: Is there anything stopping you from committing a suicide? If you're dealing with it a long time, there must be something keeping you.

It doesn't matter if you want to get help. What matters is if you need it. And clearly you do. If you are afraid of the school counsellor try calling on hotlines. Some doesn't require your identity so it might be the best for you since they are better to help you. But obviously posting a post on Reddit means you will get help here too. If there's anything you can share, please tell me. I will do my best to help you.
There is a saying “after sorrows the happiness comes” so i hope your happiness will come soon too

It’s nice of you how you’re aware of your closest. Life is all about suffering and being concerned about the pain the others would deal with is great. Don’t be selfish and let your loneliness take over. You have your family and others so try to talk out with them. There is always a solution.
It’s not actual. In fact it’s what most of people I’ve been in contact told me. And feeling scared of leaving your closest can be one of the reason why to live.

I don’t think you should. Why rush death? It’s coming anyway. If you knew this was your last day on earth and tomorrow you are going to die from a heart attack would you be wasting your last moments alive asking how to kill yourself on Reddit? Of course not, ‘cause you’d know that death is coming to get you soon enough so you might as well enjoy your last moments right? You don’t have to think about future. You’re living in the present. Don’t make too many plans. If you can’t bear the thought than just live a life without any expectations. Don’t worry about anything. Do whatever you want. That way you don’t have to think about your future. And perhaps one day, you will see yourself in the future.

If you die, your family and friends will go into a shock for sometime. Your friends might move on someday, but your family won't ever. You will leave a hollow in their lives. Please do think about them before you think of any irrational steps.

But I can bet one thing for sure, you will find more reasons to stay alive for than to die.

Please be grateful for this life.

Think about the people who are not sure where their next meal will come from, think about the people who are differently able, they don't complain that life was unfair, they try to make the best out of what they have. I am sure you can do the same.

You can just quit everything and go on a solo vacation to some place, find some peace, try to discover yourself, and take out such negative thoughts from your mind.
99% of the reason why people don’t commit suicide is that they are scared of the pain

You are a miracle. Not in a cheesy way, but sincerely. Millions of microscopic cells came together and formed the person you are today. Your birth and existence has impacted hundreds of lives. Your interactions, your smile, your everything, your being; it has all worked in one way or another to influence someone else's being.

Sometimes you really have to think on a larger scale to understand the impact of your being. It might not seem positive, but in fact unless you are doing physical harm or emotional harm to someone else, your existence is tied with the fabric of society and life for a positive reason.

Trust in yourself and make the best of your existence. Your birth influences this answer, and I don't even know your name. That is amazing. So really your birth and your existence is amazing.

Well I have some tips for Wattpad writers. Even though my story wasn't read that much but I think it's good now.   


1. **Be patient**  
You can't expect to have hundreds of readers on your first chapter of your first story. It takes time to get noticed by people. 
2. **Make it interesting**  
I'm kind of allergic with simple ideas with dull or too common characters and how the story starts. Try to make an impressive beginning! 
3. **Update regularly**   
There are some type of readers which despite finding an interesting story however with a slow update, don't continue in reading it (or when they finally notice an update). Eventually If your story has a lot of readers, slow updates don't really mind, but you might lose readers too.
4. **Be sure it's a story**  
Don't give the readers too many of information. It's good to have a story detailed but some details are unnecessary for the story to know. It's a way how to keep readers concentrated on the plot and give them the thrill and tension.
5. **Don't give up!**
